meta.source: github.com/gimanainidit/website_triad_proteksiber@main (frontend/src/index.css, tailwind.config.ts, assets/logo-protx.png) + PRO-TX SIBER Logo Guidelines 2026 + Eranusasiber logo artwork + Mistral AI design-system sample (type: DM Serif Display / Inter / JetBrains Mono)

tokens.name: navy-950
tokens.usage: Brand ink. Sampled from the ERANUSASIBER wordmark. Logo ink, hero grounds, the first stop of the shield stripe. White on it is 18.9:1.

tokens.name: navy-900
tokens.usage: Deep TRIAD navy (from the repo's earlier shield favicon). Code blocks, promo banner, dark photographic cards. White on it is 17.7:1.

tokens.name: protx-navy
tokens.usage: Official PRO-TX SIBER NAVY (Logo Guidelines §02, RGB 32 45 104). The required ground for the reversed TRIAD logo: logo tiles, favicon, brand blocks. White on it is 12.8:1.

tokens.name: electric-blue
tokens.usage: Official PRO-TX SIBER ELECTRIC BLUE (Guidelines §02, RGB 7 139 232): technology accent and circuit motifs. 3.6:1 on white, so the guideline itself forbids it for small text. Use for icons, rules and display accents.

tokens.name: light-gray
tokens.usage: Official PRO-TX SIBER LIGHT GRAY (Guidelines §02): the light background behind logo presentations and print. protx-navy on it is 11.7:1.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary CTA fill and active states. Light: repo --primary hsl(236 43% 30%). Dark: shield blue, matching the repo's .dark swap of primary to a bright blue. Pair with on-primary.

tokens.name: primary-deep
tokens.usage: Pressed state of primary. Derived: one step darker in light, one step lighter in dark, so on-primary stays legible (14.1:1 light, 7.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary. 12.0:1 on light primary, 5.7:1 on dark primary.

tokens.name: shield-blue
tokens.usage: The shared signature blue of both marks (TRIAD #0098ff, ERANUSASIBER shield #0095fa). Use for icons, large display accents of 24px or more, and stripe stops. 3.1:1 on white, so never use it for small text on light grounds.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Repo --accent hsl(207 78% 43%) in light. In dark, the repo's bright blue hsl(207 78% 51%). Use for the hero emphasis span ('dari Ancaman Siber.'), eyebrows and icon accents. 4.8:1 on canvas (light), 5.1:1 on background (dark).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links, segmented-tab active text, footer links, text-sized blue. Light value sampled from the lockup tagline ('BERSAMA JAGA RUANG SIBER'): 4.8:1 on white. Dark value is derived: 7.2:1 on background.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Derived blue tint that replaces Mistral's cream. Used for the featured pricing card, feature-icon tiles, contact panel and badge-soft. Ink on it is 10.7:1.

tokens.name: accent-soft-border
tokens.usage: Derived 1px border for accent-soft surfaces (Mistral's beige-deep role).

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px outline with a 2px offset. Repo --ring hsl(207 78% 51%). 3.5:1 on white and 5.1:1 on dark, which passes the 3:1 bar for focus indicators.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page background. Repo --background (light) and --dark / .dark --background (dark).

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Card, input and nav surface. Repo --card.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Quiet secondary surface: table stripes, hover wells, the pill-tab track. Repo --secondary.

tokens.name: surface-code
tokens.usage: IDE and code-block surface, the same in both themes.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Default 1px borders and dividers. Repo --border.

tokens.name: hairline-strong
tokens.usage: Derived stronger 1px border for inputs and secondary buttons. It is decorative: the input's label and placeholder carry meaning, not the border alone.

tokens.name: ink-strong
tokens.usage: Display and heading text (hero-display, display-lg, heading-1 to heading-4). 18.9:1 on canvas.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text. Repo --foreground. 12.1:1 on canvas and 11.3:1 on background.

tokens.name: steel
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, inactive tabs. Repo --muted-foreground and --dark-muted. 4.8:1 on canvas and 4.5:1 on background (light). 6.4:1 on canvas (dark).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Disabled text and placeholders only, never meaningful text. Intentionally below 4.5:1.

tokens.name: on-dark
tokens.usage: Text on navy-950, navy-900 and surface-code.

tokens.name: on-dark-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on navy grounds. Repo --dark-muted. 6.7:1 on navy-900.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Error fills and icons. Repo --destructive. FLAG: the light value is only 3.8:1 with white, so use white text at 18px bold or larger, or put error text in ink next to a destructive icon.

tokens.name: on-destructive
tokens.usage: Text on destructive. Repo --destructive-foreground.

tokens.name: stripe-1
tokens.usage: Shield stripe stop 1 of 5 (left).

tokens.name: stripe-2
tokens.usage: Shield stripe stop 2: TRIAD indigo.

tokens.name: stripe-3
tokens.usage: Shield stripe stop 3: lockup tagline blue.

tokens.name: stripe-4
tokens.usage: Shield stripe stop 4: shared shield blue.

tokens.name: stripe-5
tokens.usage: Shield stripe stop 5 (right): light tint fading into the footer.

families.serif: "DM Serif Display", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif

styles.name: hero-display
styles.usage: One per page, in the hero band. DM Serif Display, as in the Mistral sample (hero 'Frontier AI'). Steps down 84 → 72 → 60 → 48 → 40px.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Section openers. Size and leading kept from the repo's hero h1 (lg:text-7xl, leading-[1.1]); the face is now DM Serif Display. The Mistral sample sets display-lg at 64px. Responsive: 36 / 48 / 60 / 72px at base / sm / md / lg.

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: Page headlines and the CTA banner.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Subsection headlines. Inter 500, as in the Mistral sample.

styles.name: heading-5
styles.usage: Small card titles and FAQ questions.

styles.name: subtitle
styles.sample: Mitra keamanan siber enterprise untuk Indonesia.

styles.name: body-md
styles.sample: Evaluasi menyeluruh terhadap kebijakan dan kontrol keamanan.

styles.name: body-sm-medium
styles.usage: Nav links, active tabs, form labels.

styles.name: micro-uppercase
styles.usage: Uppercase section eyebrows and footer column titles (Mistral sample). Colour: link on light, shield-blue on navy.

styles.name: tagline
styles.usage: Uppercase, very wide-tracked brand line that echoes the ERANUSASIBER lockup tagline (about 0.3em). Under the logo, in the footer and on the cover only.

styles.name: code-md
styles.usage: Code blocks and terminal mockups. JetBrains Mono, as in the Mistral sample.

spacing.note: 4px base, 8px primary increment (Mistral rhythm). The repo uses the Tailwind default scale, which these values sit on.

tokens.name: space-xxs
tokens.usage: Icon and label gaps.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Tight stacks and pill-tab vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Input vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Form field gap, code-block padding.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding, stat-cell padding.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Compact card padding.

tokens.name: space-2xl
tokens.usage: Feature, pricing and form panel padding. Container gutter (repo container padding 2rem).

tokens.name: space-3xl
tokens.usage: Large gaps inside hero content.

tokens.name: section-sm
tokens.usage: Compact section rhythm.

tokens.name: section
tokens.usage: Content page section rhythm.

tokens.name: section-lg
tokens.usage: Marketing page section rhythm.

tokens.name: hero
tokens.usage: Hero band vertical padding on desktop.

radius.note: Sober, editorial geometry: no pill buttons. sm, md and lg are the repo's --radius scale (0.5rem minus 4px and 2px).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small chips and micro-controls. Repo rounded-sm.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Compact UI and code-block inner elements. Repo rounded-md.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs and code blocks. Repo --radius (rounded-lg).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards, panels and modals: the dominant card radius (Mistral).

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Hero band and CTA banner.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Badges and pill tabs only. Never buttons.

shadow.note: Mostly flat. Navy-tinted shadows replace Mistral's neutral black.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Subtle lift: nav on scroll, hovered tiles.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Product feature cards.

tokens.name: shadow-3
tokens.usage: IDE and terminal mockups.

tokens.name: shadow-4
tokens.usage: Modals, dropdowns, popovers.

breakpoint.note: Tailwind defaults used by the repo. The container is centred, with 2rem padding and a 1400px maximum at 2xl.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Hero 48px; feature tiles 2-up.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Hero 60px; 2-column grids; stat row goes horizontal.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Hero 72px; full nav replaces the hamburger; 2-column hero.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: Full 84px hero-display; 4-up pricing.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Repo container screens.2xl.
